name: La Pobla de Claramunt (Spain)
description: Quartered, the first and fourth quarters yellow with a red mount surmounted by a fleur-de-lis, the second and third red with a yellow thistle.
history: Municipal flag of La Pobla de Claramunt; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: mount surmounted by a fleur-de-lis in the yellow quarters
